DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology, and a trip to the principal, and her call time ran out too, so the fair outcome of a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you gave her a detector score and impressions about his writing but no dated document she could check herself.
What cost ground: Repeating that Owen cheated, again and again, with nothing new to show, which only hardened her and pushed her back toward the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because no times or dates were put on the table, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked which phrase he did not understand, name that phrase and put it next to a sample of his other work, so she has something she can check.
